{{Infobox character | name = Gneiss | image = Gneiss.png | race = Hearthian | planet = Timber Hearth | location = Village }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Hearthian]] found playing a banjo in a rocking chair outside of their home. They are responsible for having created all of the instruments used by the various [[travelers]] in game. == Dialogue == === Initial Conversation === * “Hello there, space cadet!
I hear you're leaving the crater today.
If you meet any of the other travelers up there, remind them to take proper care of their instruments, won't you?” **'''>Tell me about the travelers' instruments.''' *** [[#Instruments|Instruments]] ** '''>Where's the [[observatory]]?''' *** [[#Observatory|Observatory]] ** '''>Just saying hi before I leave.''' *** “Take care of yourself up in space!” === Followup Conversation === * “Trouble is, every time a Hearthian leaves for outer space, that's one less musician in our orchestra.
So! Did you need something?” **'''>Tell me about the travelers' instruments.''' *** [[#Instruments|Instruments]] ** '''>Where's the observatory?''' *** [[#Observatory|Observatory]] ** '''>Nah, I’m good.''' *** “Take care of yourself up in space!” === After going to Space === * “Everything okay? Seems kind of early for you to be back from space.
Did you need something from me?” **'''>Tell me about the travelers' instruments.''' *** [[#Instruments|Instruments]] ** '''>I’m good,actually.''' *** “Alright. Take care, now.” === Instruments === * “Oh, sure! I made all of their instruments, you know. Let me see... There's [[Chert]]'s drums, [[Riebeck]]'s banjo, and [[Gabbro]]'s flute.
And [[Feldspar]]'s harmonica, of course, though Feldspar's been missing for a long time. Sometimes it feels like just yesterday they were playing their harmonica around the campfire...
Anyway, you hear music in space, that'll be one of the space program's other travelers. If you feel like company, you can always pull out your [[Signalscope]] and track them down.” === Observatory === * “It's questions like that what make us worried about you going up into space on your own, you know.
The observatory is up the path behind the waterfall. There are a couple of signs marking the way, but really, you just keep going up and then hook a right when you get to the [[Village#Zero-G Cave|zero-g cave]].” == Trivia == * [[Tektite]] advises [[the protagonist]] not to tell Gneiss about the harmonica music coming from the [[Dark Bramble]] seed in [[Youngbark Crater]] because "they'll never let me get rid of this darn seed if they suspect it has any musical talent." * [[Esker]]'s signalscope log records that after increasing uneasiness about the harmonica music coming from Timber Hearth, they wonder if they should consult Gneiss about whether the scope is broken. * As all Hearthians they are named after minerals. [[wikipedia:Gneiss|Gneiss]] is a common and widely distributed type of metamorphic rock. [[Category:Characters]] [[Category:Hearthians]]
